Authorisation: she "understand[s] that choosing the lump sum is your own decision and that you have to sign the election yourself"; supplies 20 % withholding and direct deposit to the September account when asked; is "happy for the agent to take care of whatever Ashgrove needs to do on its side". ### 4. Scored parameters
**(A) Arrears installment for 2026-08-12** (hub "Certain Installments Unpaid While a Death Claim Was Pending"; computation "Income Annuities Arrears Installment Settlement…")
- Gross: baseline "paid at the current installment on the contract" ($544.27) is displaced by factor "Gross Amount of an Arrears Certain Installment…" rule (a): cola_pct 0.01; a cost-of-living increase took effect on the 2026-09-01 anniversary (issue 2008-09-01; ledger shows 538.88 -> 544.27 between 08 and 09 payment dates), after the last annuitant installment (2026-07-12); nothing held for 2026-08-12 (suspense 0.00, no held row). Anniversaries after 2026-07-12 and on or before 2026-08-12: none -> "the amount is the last installment issued to the annuitant, unraised" = **538.88**.

Already recovered = (78,600.00 − (−28,048.59)) × 0.666 = 71,027.96. 41,500.00 − 71,027.96 < 0 -> tax-free part 0.00 ("never less than zero"); taxable 538.88.

- State: factor "State Income Tax Withholding on … Arrears Installments" — issue_state NY -> alternative 4 %; federal withheld on the arrears and on installments in the prior twelve months (37.72 per month etc.) -> 538.88 × 4 % = **21.56**.
- Interest: factor "Interest Start Date … by State of Issue" — NY -> from date of death 2026-07-27 to payment (2026-10-07) = 72 days. Factor "Claims Interest Rate Table" — NY, days since due proof (2026-08-10 -> 2026-10-07 = 58) > 30 -> 6 %. 538.88 × 6 % × 72/365 = 6.3780 -> **6.38**.
- Amount sent = 538.88 + 6.38 − 53.89 − 21.56 = **469.81**. Payment method: "by the payment method on the contract" = direct_deposit. payee_name "Claire Brennan-Ortiz".

**(B) Commuted value** (computation "Actuarial Basis of the Commuted Value…")
- Election day 2026-10-07; next payment date 2026-10-12 (5 days).
- Count: factor "Installments Counted … by Contract Status", beneficiary continuing -> one per payment date 2026-10-12 … 2028-09-12 = 24; unissued arrears added undiscounted = 0 once 2026-08-12 stands issued. Factor "The Installment Falling Due Near the Election Day": 1–10 days -> 2026-10-12 "left out of the commuted count and paid on its own schedule" -> **23** discounted installments (2026-11-12 … 2028-09-12).
- Spread: factor "Commutation Discount Spread by Remaining Certain Term": whole months 2026-10-07 -> 2028-09-12 = 23 < 24 -> 0.5 %. Pricing 4.85 % + 0.5 % = 5.35 %. Factor "Floor for Seasoned Contracts and Cap": in force 2008-09-01 -> 2026-10-07 = 217 months >= 120 and 5.35 % < 5.5 % -> annual rate **5.5 %**; per period 1.055^(1/12) − 1.
- First discount period: factor "Discount Period of the First Commuted Installment": within 10 days -> (5 + 30.4375)/30.4375 = 1.16427 periods; each later one further period.
- Cost of living: factor "Cost-of-Living Growth in the Commuted Value": 23 months < 36 -> year by year; anniversary 1 September: 10 installments (2026-11 … 2027-08) at 544.27, 12 (2027-09 … 2028-08) at 549.7127, 1 (2028-09) at 555.2098; only the total rounded (baseline "Only the total is rounded").
- Commuted value = **11,932.61**.
- Fall-back (baseline only): count 240 − 214 = 26 level installments of 544.27, spread 1 % (5.85 %), first discounted one period -> **13,282.65** — definite and different.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone
- Root problem P1: pay the commuted value as a lump sum (customer's ask).
- Hop P1 <- P2 (**state-derived**). Sentence in hub "Payment of an Elected Commuted Value": "**Standing condition.** The commuted value is not paid until a commutation election signed by the beneficiary stands approved on the contract." Query: find_income_annuity_service_requests shows only death_claim, withholding_election, bank_change — no commutation election. Search with the sentence's words "commutation election … approved" lands on "Beneficiary's Election of a Commuted Value", whose Effect says "The signed election is filed on the contract as an approved commutation election signed by the beneficiary" — the write that brings the state about, owned by the customer.
- Hop P2 <- P3 (**state-derived**). Sentence in hub "Beneficiary's Election of a Commuted Value": "**When the value is fixed.** The commuted value is fixed only after every certain installment that fell due between the date of death and the approval of the death claim stands issued to the beneficiary on the contract's activity history." Query: death 2026-07-27, claim approved 2026-08-24, payment dates in that span: 2026-08-12; activity shows no issued row for it. Search with "certain installment … fell due … death … approval … issued to the beneficiary" lands on "Certain Installments Unpaid While a Death Claim Was Pending", whose rule makes it an arrears installment owed to Claire and whose Effect says "Each arrears payment appears on the contract's activity history as an installment issued to the beneficiary for its payment date" — the write that brings the state about.
- P3 has no waited-on state in its documents. Handling order: P3 -> P2 -> P1. No hop was pre-solved: no document named another problem's tool or stated a route.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only what she asked" (hand over the election / pay the lump sum straight away): the election hub says the value "is not yet fixed" while the 2026-08-12 installment does not stand issued; the payment hub says nothing is paid without an approved election. Excluded by visible sentences + records.
- Closest alternatives: (i) fold the unpaid August installment into the commuted value undiscounted (count factor's second sentence) — excluded because the value cannot be fixed while that installment is unissued; (ii) pay the arrears at the current $544.27 — excluded by arrears-amount rule (a), zero anniversaries in range; (iii) owner's 7 % election on the arrears — excluded by "an election made by the owner does not govern another person's payments"; (iv) include the 2026-10-12 installment — excluded by the cutoff factor (1–10 days); (v) spread 1 % / rate 5.85 % — excluded by the term-left rate card and the floor; (vi) interest from due-proof date at 3.5 % — excluded for NY by the period and rate tables; (vii) "payment date" in the interest clause read as the scheduled date 2026-08-12 — excluded by "Death-claim interest rate … from the date due proof is received to payment" and the rate table's edges ("paid 31 March (30 days)").
- Visible-surface note: the contract number IA50731846 is not accepted as `income_contract_id`; the contract is reachable through `payee_customer_id` (schema text: "the survivor or beneficiary now receiving the payments").

Blind verdict: the visible surface yields a unique solution: arrears 538.88/469.81, commuted value 11,932.61 at 20 %, lump-sum net 9,068.79.
